title: Konami Unveils Concept Trailer for Konami Wai Wai World Craft Game Creation System
content:
Konami unveiled during its Konami Press Start livestream on Thursday a concept trailer for Konami Wai Wai World Craft , a new user-generated content (UGC) game platform that features characters from various Konami franchises.

The game allows players to design their own game by selecting a classic Konami game, such as Castlevania , as a base for game assets. Players can then define the game's rules and mechanics. Alternatively, players can type a prompt and the project will "generate" a game within three minutes. Players can also share their creations with other players online.

The project's title evokes Konami Wai Wai World platformer for the Nintendo Famicom console, which featured a crossover of Konami 's characters.

Konami did not reveal a release date for the project.
author: ANN

title: GKIDS Responds to Incorrectly Timed Subtitles During The Last Blossom Film Screenings, Reviews Options for Makeup Screenings, Confirms cocoon Anime Will Screen as Planned
content:
"On Sunday, GKIDS became aware of a subtitling glitch in our DCP for The Last Blossom . We immediately instructed theaters to remove shows from sale and issue refunds to affected customers until we could identify and resolve the issue. On Monday, we were able to provide a corrected version of the film to theaters. While some were able to update their screenings, others were unfortunately unable to do so in time, resulting in canceled shows. We deeply apologize for this issue and to all moviegoers affected, whether you attended a screening or had one canceled. We brought The Last Blossom to cinemas because it is a distinctive and wonderfully original work, and we are sorry that we fell short of the presentation that audiences expect. GKIDS believes the theatrical experience is central to film culture, and we know the time and sacrifice fans make to share this experience together. We are currently reviewing options including makeup screenings of the corrected version, to ensure audiences can experience this special film. Thank you for your patience and support as we work to put this right."

GKIDS had initially planned to only screen the film on August 30-31. However, theatergoers had posted that English subtitles were off by several seconds during screenings on Sunday, and some screenings had been cancelled for Monday.

ANN reached out to GKIDS . GKIDS confirmed with ANN that it is reviewing its options and possible makeup screenings of the corrected verision. The company also provided the following statement regarding cancellations of its planned screenings of cocoon – One Summer of Girlhood ( cocoon Aru Natsu no Shōjo-tachi Yori ), the anime of Machiko Kyō 's Cocoon manga:

" Cocoon will continue to screen as planned, opening in theaters September 4. In the leadup to opening it's common for a few theaters to make adjustments to their schedule, which may result in added or changed locations.

GKIDS will begin screening the Cocoon anime in theaters in North America on September 4 in Japanese with English subtitles and with an English dub . GKIDS will also release the anime on home video.

title: Sword Art Online's Echoes of Aincrad Game's Trailer Reveals 'Genesis Maidens' DLC
content:
Bandai Namco Entertainment unveiled during Sony 's State of Play on Thursday a video for Echoes of Aincrad , the new action RPG based on Reki Kawahara 's Sword Art Online franchise , and it announces the "Genesis Maidens" DLC. The DLC, which features Mito from the Sword Art Online: Progressive films, launches this winter.

The DLC has a new storyline across new areas of Floors 1-2 of Aincrad. The DLC also includes the Curved Sword weapon type along with Mito, and introduces armor enhancement.

The game launched in Japan on PlayStation 5 and Xbox Series X|S on July 9, and on PC via Steam on July 10. In the West, it launched on all these platforms on July 10.

Aimer performs the theme song "Live to Survive."

The game has a Standard Edition, Deluxe Edition, Ultimate Edition, and Aincrad Edition release. The Deluxe Edition includes the expansion DLC and a starter item pack, as well as early access to the game's "Death Game" mode (a mode where the game deletes your save on character death, and is normally available only after beating the game for the first time). The Ultimate Edition includes the Deluxe Edition content, and adds the "Unanswered//butterfly" bonus content app/special anime, digital soundtrack, digital artbook, and an in-game armor pack. The Aincrad Edition is exclusive to the Bandai Namco Store, and includes the Deluxe and Ultimate Edition content, adding a beanie, wall scroll, patches, and sticker pack.

The bundled "Unanswered//butterfly" bonus special promotional anime is included with the Ultimate and Premium Editions of the game and follows other characters during the events of the original Sword Art Online story.

Reki Kawahara began the Sword Art Online web novel in 2001, and serialized it from 2002 to 2008 on his website. Kadokawa 's Dengeki Bunko label began publishing a newly edited print version in 2009, ending the original story with the "Alicization" arc as Kawahara had wrote it in his website with the 18th volume in 2016. The novel series returned with an all-new "Moon Cradle" story arc in 2017, and another all-new "Unital Ring" story arc in 2018, and is now in its 29th overall volume. The series has inspired novel and manga spinoffs, a television anime adaptation with several seasons, an anime film, and proposed live-action series . Kawahara's Sword Art Online: Progressive spinoff novel series inspired two anime films of its own.

title: Digimon Story Time Stranger Game Reveals 'A Hero's Eternal Legacy' DLC Expansion
content:
Bandai Namco Entertainment America revealed during Sony 's State of Play livestream on Thursday a trailer for its Digimon Story Time Stranger game , and it announces the major DLC expansion "A Hero's Eternal Legacy." The new expansion will take place three years after the original game, and it will feature a new hero and over 50 additional Digimon .

The DLC expansion will launch in 2027.

The game launched for PlayStation 5, Xbox Series X|S, and PC via Steam in October 2025. The game launched for Nintendo Switch and Nintendo Switch 2 on July 10. The Switch 2 version features improved graphics as well as performance mode and quality mode.

The game's first DLC pack "Additional Digimon & Episode Pack 1: Alternate Dimension" launched on December 8. The DLC pack includes new story content, as well as Digivolution routes for Mega Digimon . The DLC is part of the season pass, which includes two more episode packs. The game's second DLC pack "Additional Digimon & Episode Pack 2: GAKU-RAN" launched on January 22. The third DLC pack "Additional Digimon & Episode Pack 3 Anti-ParadoX" launched on March 11 (March 12 in Japan).

Singer-songwriter reche performs the game's theme song "wherever you are."

Bandai Namco Entertainment announced in March a new mobile game titled Digimon UP . The game launched on July 15. Bandai Namco describes the game's concept built around "a Digimon journey that moves with your life."

title: Stupid Never Dies Game's 3rd Trailer Reveals Demo
content:
Osaka-based game development studio GPTrack50 unveiled during Sony 's Stage of Play livestream on Thursday the third trailer for Stupid Never Dies action game , and it reveals that a two-hour playable demo has launched. Save data from the First Bite demo can transfer to the full game upon launch.

The game will launch for PlayStation 5 and PC via Steam on October 21 (October 22 in some regions). Sega will distribute the game.

The company describes the game:

Julia has frozen to death. Monsters roam the streets. How did the world end up like this…? Davy, the timid zombie protagonist, has one dream: to bring Julia back to life and take her on a date. To make that dream come true, he ventures into a dangerous otherworldly dungeon. There will be times when powerful enemies leave him completely battered—but with the support of his eccentric companions, Davy keeps pushing forward. Bite, Rip, Rise to your way to the top! Stupid Never Dies—the underdog adventure of the weakest zombie rising against all odds.

The game is getting "TickTock Teddies: Nonsense Overload Pack" DLC.

DAVY & JULIA perform the opening theme song "Stupid Never Dies" by , and DAVY performs the ending theme song "Restless, Reckless, Never Die, Fearless."

Former CAPCOM producer Hiroyuki Kobayashi established GPTrack50. Kobayashi produced such titles as the first six Resident Evil games, Dino Crisis , Devil May Cry and Devil May Cry 4 , and the Sengoku Basara series at CAPCOM .
author: ANN

title: Cygames Announces Where the Seeds Fall Game From Newly Established Label CygamesEdge
content:
Cygames announced a new label on Thursday CygamesEdge for small and mid-sized teams. CygamesEdge unveiled during Sony 's State of Play livestream on Thursday its debut game Where the Seeds Fall from ZEREO. The company later revealed that the game will launch for PlayStation 5, Nintendo Switch 2, and PC via Steam on November 5.

The company describes the action-adventure game:

The earth has been afflicted with Blight, forcing humanity to build new homes upon the branches of the World Tree. It is a place fraught with peril, and in their fear, humanity has branded "Fell Children" as omens of disaster. After encountering a Fell Child, however, one soldier goes against orders and determines to escort them to the surface world. Descend the World Tree by navigating ruins, reading the wind, and taking leaps of faith in this thrilling action-adventure game.

Media advertising company CyberAgent established Cygames in 2011, and the company has produced games such as Uma Musume Pretty Derby , Rage of Bahamut , and Granblue Fantasy . Cygames established an anime division in March 2015 and the anime production subsidiary Cygames Pictures in April 2016. The company has worked on anime productions inspired by its games including Uma Musume Pretty Derby , Rage of Bahamut Genesis , Rage of Bahamut: Virgin Soul , and Granblue Fantasy the Animation .

title: Giant Ojo-sama Anime Reveals First Trailer, Yu Serizawa and Junya Enoki Lead Voice Cast
content:
Giant Ojo-sama ( Giant Young Lady ) anime revealed the first trailer, along with the main voice cast. The anime previously confirmed a January 2027 release date . Studio Tatsunoko Production is in charge of the animation.

Based on the manga by Nikumura Q, the comedy follows Oriko Fujido, the daughter of an ultra-wealthy family who receives an entire city as a birthday present. Armed with a giantification drink created by her butler and scientist Dr. Sebastian, Oriko grows to enormous size to defend the city from invading threats, though she often causes just as much destruction herself.

Yu Serizawa voice protagonist Oriko, while Junya Enoki ( Yuji in JUJUTSU KAISEN ) will play Dr. Sebastian. You can watch the first trailer below.

You can also see the two main characters in the previously revealed teaser visual.

The adaptation will be directed by Hiroshi Ikehata, whose previous credits include TONIKAWA: Over the Moon for You and Tearmoon Empire . Katsuya Oshima will serve as assistant director, with Yu Mitsuya handling series composition and scripts. Hajime Mitsuda is in charge of character designs and serves as chief animation director.

Giant Ojo-sama began serialization on Shogakukan’s Sunday Webry manga platform on July 30, 2021. The series was originally published as a webcomic on Shueisha’s Jump Rookie website on December 17, 2020. The first collected volume was released on November 12, 2021, and as of November 2025, the series has been compiled into eleven volumes. Volume 12 is set to release in Japan on August 10. The official website describes the story: Fujido Oriko, the daughter of a wealthy businessman, was given a “city” as a present on her fourth birthday. She nurtures and grows the city until one day, a giant enemy appears and threatens its peace. In the midst of the crisis, her butler, Sebastian, hands her a mysterious growth drink, leading to an unexpected transformation. A comedy series where the bigger things get, the more lovable they become.
author: Anime Corner

title: The Apothecary Diaries Is Going Live-Action & It Already Has the Creator’s Approval
content:
The Apothecary Diaries is one of the largest franchises in recent years, known for its exceptional story and gorgeous animation. Written by Hyūganatsu, the critically acclaimed light novel received an anime adaptation in 2023, and the series only continues to grow in popularity. The first two seasons of the anime have been major hits, boosting the sales of the light novel and the manga adaptations. 2026 is by far the most exciting year for fans thanks to the upcoming third season and the first feature-length movie . The third season is only a month away, while the movie is set to release in December this year. As fans await the anime’s return, Prime Video confirmed the first-ever live-action adaptation of the series.

Considering that the light novel has been ongoing since 2014, the announcement is a major win for the series. The official X handle of Prime Video confirmed the live-action, titled Intelligence Declassified, will be released in a drama format, although the exact number of episodes hasn’t been revealed yet. Additionally, the drama will premiere in 2028 exclusively on the platform. Mana Ashida, a renowned Japanese actress and singer, will be playing the role of Maomao, and more cast members will be introduced at a later date. The announcement immediately went viral with millions of impressions, and even the creator quoted the post with a special message for fans.

The Apothecary Diaries Creator Shares Thoughts on The Live-Action Drama

In her official X handle , Hyūganatsu shared, “We’re doing a live-action adaptation. I checked it out, and the casting is so spot-on it practically leaps off the page, along with sets and props that form a perfect tableau all on their own.”

She also added, “The script is bold, but written without any sense of awkwardness—truly impressive. Also, it might be hard to tell from the teaser, but it’s a wig with this bizarre, subtle shade that turns faintly green when the light hits it.”

While the author didn’t share major updates on the upcoming adaptation, she did confirm that the casting has her approval. For now, only the actress playing the role of Maomao has been revealed, but more cast members have already been confirmed, and fans will learn about them later. Additionally, Prime Video also shared a teaser visual along with the announcement. The author confirmed that while the hair color is dark, it does have a faint green color. In the light novel and manga art as well, Maomao has a darker shade of hair color, unlike the anime, which highlights her green hair.

We might see the same change in Jinshi as well, whose hair color is actually described as black in the novel, unlike the anime. Additionally, it wouldn’t be surprising if the drama deviated from the main story a little, considering how the author described it as “bold.” Since the creator has nothing but praise for the live-action, fans are all the more reassured regarding the adaptation.

The Apothecary Diaries Season 3 Will Premiere in a Month

The third season will begin streaming on October 2nd as part of the Fall 2026 anime lineup. Unlike the first two seasons, which released both their cours simultaneously, the third season will only air its first cour in the Fall 2026 season. The anime will return with part of the third season in Spring 2027.

The first cour will adapt Volume 5 of the light novel, where Maomao will solve the mystery behind the strange incidents in the northern farming villages. The anime will return to Crunchyroll, where you can also catch up with the first two seasons. As for the movie, it will hit Japanese theatres on December 11th, 2026, but international fans will have to wait until next year to watch it.

title: Rev. Noir Game's Trailers Reveal 2027 Release, Preview Story/Combat (Updated)
content:
Konami Digital Entertainment unveiled during Sony 's State of Play livestream on Thursday the second trailer for its new role-playing game Rev. Noir . Update: Konami later revealed that the game will launch for PlayStation 5, Xbox Series X|S, and PC via Steam in 2027. The video previews the story and combat gameplay:

Update: The company later unveiled a second trailer focused on the story:

The single-player game is currently only slated for the PlayStation 5.

Sony describes the game:

When Hope Sparks Catastrophe In a world shrouded in lightfall, a natural phenomenon that brings death to those it touches, A lonely boy who suffers from amnesia becomes acquainted with a special girl. Together, they set out on a journey to stop this phenomenon, Believing that the journey will save the world, and in turn, save her. Fate, bestowed by the Gods? Or the power of will, borne from within humankind? Their journey ends up shaking the world. Unravel the mandate of heaven, and weave together the threads of hope in this completely new RPG experience.

Nobuki Kadoi is producing the game. Kadoi stated during the stream that the team are striving to place elements that define a JRPG — meeting comrades, growth, and heartfelt moments — at the core of the game's narrative.

Updated: Added story trailer.

Nobuki Kadoi is producing the game. Kadoi stated during the stream that the team are striving to place elements that define a JRPG — meeting comrades, growth, and heartfelt moments — at the core of the game's narrative.

title: NIS America Announces The Eminence in Shadow: Phantom Echoes Game
content:
NIS America announced during Sony 's State of Play livestream on Thursday The Eminence in Shadow : Phantom Echoes , a new 3D action roguelite game based on Daisuke Aizawa 's The Eminence in Shadow ( Kage no Jitsuryokusha ni Naritakute! ) light novel series. The game will launch for PlayStation 5, Nintendo Switch 2, and PC via Steam and Epic Games Store in 2027. The company unveiled the first trailer, which previews the gameplay:

The game stars Alpha, who can have different abilities through an Awakening system. The video also features Delta and Shadow.

Aizawa began serializing the story on the "Shōsetsuka ni Narō" (Let's Become Novelists) website in May 2018, and Kadokawa began publishing the story in physical volumes with art by Tōzai , beginning with the first volume in November 2018. Anri Sakano launched the manga adaptation in Kadokawa 's Comp Ace magazine in December 2018. Seta U launched a spinoff manga titled Kage no Jitsuryokusha ni Naritakute! Shadow Gaiden ( The Eminence in Shadow: Shadow Side Story ) in Comp Ace in July 2019.

Yen Press licensed both the light novels and the manga adaptation.

The first season of the television anime premiered in October 2022, and it ended in February 2023. The second season premiered in October 2023. HIDIVE streamed the anime as it aired in Japan along with a same-day English dub . HIDIVE and Kadokawa held a world premiere screening of the second season at Anime Expo in July 2023.

The Eminence in Shadow - Lost Echoes ( Kage no Jitsuryokusha ni Naritakute!: Zankyō-hen ) film will open in 2027.

The Eminence in Shadow : Master of Garden game launched for iOS, Android, and PC in November 2022. Crunchyroll Games released the game in English.
